_comment: The project's KPI: the minimum clock period of XSCore, one row per
measured run. Add a row when a change moves it, run kpi.py, commit
both. min_period_ps is the SDC period minus the worst slack of the
reg2reg group, which is the only group that can fail timing closure;
see .claude/commands/odb-debug.md for how to ask a checkpoint for it,
and .claude/skills/macro-constraints for why the other groups are not
the number. Ask for the group by name: on VecRegionModule the overall
worst slack is -2006 ps and belongs to another group, while reg2reg is
-1564 ps, and only the second one is the period.
blocks is the same measurement on each hardened block alone, at its own
place stage through <block>_place_odb_debug, against an ideal clock:
what the top level would approach if the clock reached the logic. The
top level number is the one that carries a clock tree.
The target is 800 ps. When the period approaches it, this file gains
the CoreMark and power columns and the study reconnects; until then
the design does not depend on it.
